verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Atlassian, Bitbucket's vendor, documents an official MCP server at github.com/atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server, so an official agent connection path exists. Nothing in the pack shows that server exposes Bitbucket repos, PRs or pipelines rather than only other Atlassian products. Missing for 10: confirmation the MCP server covers Bitbucket, documented tool list and auth/setup details, hands-on or independent corroboration.
